instituteType.title: Institute Type

embargoPeriod.title: Embargo Period

technicalInfo.description: Technical specifications and capabilities of the repository/dataset
technicalInfo.title: Technical Specifications

metadataStandards.title: Metadata Standards
metadataStandards.description: Metadata standards supported by the repository

accessProtocols.title: Access Protocols
accessProtocols.description: Protocols and methods for data access and retrieval

maintenance.title: Maintenance & Sustainability
maintenance.description: Information about system maintenance and long-term sustainability

updateFrequency.description: How frequently the system is updated/maintained

findability.title: Findability
findability.description: Assessment of how easily data can be found by both humans and computers

persistentIdentifier.title: Persistent Identifier
persistentIdentifier.description: Persistent identifiers (PIDs) uniquely and permanently identify digital objects, enabling reliable tracking and access to datasets over time. (RDA-F1-01D)
persistentIdentifier.placeholder: Toggle to confirm persistent identifier implementation...
persistentIdentifier.additional_information: High preference given to globally resolvable systems like DOIs or Handles over regional or local identifier patterns.

richMetadata.title: Rich Metadata
richMetadata.description: Rich metadata includes comprehensive descriptive, structural, and administrative information about data, facilitating discovery and reusability. (RDA-F2-01M)
richMetadata.placeholder: Toggle to confirm rich metadata depth...
richMetadata.additional_information: Evaluates whether metadata goes beyond basic transactional identity to document contextual parameters.

indexedInSearchEngines.title: Indexed in Search Engines
indexedInSearchEngines.description: Metadata indexing in search engines ensures that datasets are discoverable through standard web search tools and data discovery services. (RDA-F4-01M)
indexedInSearchEngines.placeholder: Toggle to confirm search engine crawl indexing...
indexedInSearchEngines.additional_information: Requires exposure via sitemaps, schema.org tags, or open API routing protocols.

metadataSchema.title: Metadata Schema
metadataSchema.description: Standard metadata schemas provide structured formats for describing data, enabling interoperability and consistent interpretation across systems.
metadataSchema.placeholder: Toggle to confirm standardized metadata schema alignment...
metadataSchema.additional_information: Prefer domain-specific structures accepted within international agricultural and infrastructure workflows.

metadataPersistence.title: Metadata Persistence
metadataPersistence.description: Metadata persistence ensures that descriptive information about datasets remains accessible and unchanged throughout the data lifecycle. (RDA-F1-01M)
metadataPersistence.placeholder: Toggle to confirm metadata preservation guarantee...
metadataPersistence.additional_information: Guarantees that descriptive information persists even if the source data payload is decommissioned.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: Assessment of how data can be retrieved and accessed

retrievalProtocol.title: Retrieval Protocol
retrievalProtocol.description: Standard retrieval protocols (e.g., HTTP, FTP, OAI-PMH) enable reliable and predictable access to data using established technical standards. (RDA-A1-04D)
retrievalProtocol.placeholder: Toggle to confirm standardized retrieval protocol usage...
retrievalProtocol.additional_information: Standard free open communication network systems include HTTP/HTTPS, FTP/SFTP, OAI-PMH, or REST protocols.

authenticationRequired.title: Authentication Required
authenticationRequired.description: Authentication mechanisms verify user identity before granting access to data, supporting both open and restricted access scenarios. (RDA-A1.2-02D)
authenticationRequired.placeholder: Is access identity gating currently operational?
authenticationRequired.additional_information: Checking this true indicates authorization checking is required prior to resource extraction.

authenticationType.title: Authentication Type
authenticationType.description: Different authentication types (e.g., username/password, OAuth, certificates) provide varying levels of security and usability for data access. (RDA-A1-04D)
authenticationType.placeholder: Toggle to confirm standardized identity verification...
authenticationType.additional_information: Open references indicate public extraction, while standardized implies OAuth2, Shibboleth, or API Tokens.

metadataAlwaysAvailable.title: Metadata Always Available
metadataAlwaysAvailable.description: Metadata availability independent of data access allows discovery and understanding of restricted datasets, supporting transparency and informed decisions. (RDA-A2-01M)
metadataAlwaysAvailable.placeholder: Is record index persistently readable if payload is secure?
metadataAlwaysAvailable.additional_information: Critical for legal and descriptive preservation when payload file packages are strictly confidential.

dataAvailability.title: Data Availability
dataAvailability.description: Data availability ensures that datasets are retrievable through documented, standardized access mechanisms supporting both open and controlled access policies. (RDA-A1.1-01D)
dataAvailability.placeholder: Toggle to confirm functional up-time expectations...
dataAvailability.additional_information: Measures ongoing availability and stability of source archive host servers.

interoperability.title: Interoperability
interoperability.description: Assessment of how data can be integrated with other data

knowledgeRepresentation.title: Knowledge Representation
knowledgeRepresentation.description: Formal knowledge representation using ontologies and semantic languages enables machine-interpretable descriptions of data relationships and meanings. (RDA-I1-02M/D)
knowledgeRepresentation.placeholder: Toggle to confirm semantic language classification...
knowledgeRepresentation.additional_information: Requires usage of structured machine languages like RDF, OWL, or JSON-LD graphs over flat data definitions.

vocabulariesUsed.title: Vocabularies Used
vocabulariesUsed.description: Controlled vocabularies and standard terminologies ensure consistent representation of concepts, improving data integration and semantic interoperability. (RDA-I2-02M/D)
vocabulariesUsed.placeholder: Toggle to confirm controlled vocabulary usage...
vocabulariesUsed.additional_information: Confirms use of international semantic authority classifications like AGROVOC, Crop Ontology, or ENVO.

qualifiedReferences.title: Qualified References
qualifiedReferences.description: Qualified references with resolvable identifiers enable linking between datasets and external resources, enhancing data connectivity and context. (RDA-I3-03M/D)
qualifiedReferences.placeholder: Toggle if dataset points explicitly to external semantic relations...
qualifiedReferences.additional_information: Validates if contextual links point to related resources using structured predicates instead of simple string entries.

dataFormats.title: Data Formats
dataFormats.description: Standardized, non-proprietary data formats ensure data portability and compatibility across different tools and systems. (RDA-I1-01M)
dataFormats.placeholder: Toggle to confirm open structural schema formats...
dataFormats.additional_information: Prioritize open structural schemas over encrypted or vendor-locked single-application binary encodings.

apiAvailability.title: API Availability
apiAvailability.description: Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) provide programmatic access to data, enabling automated integration with other systems and workflows. (RDA-A1-05D)
apiAvailability.placeholder: Toggle to confirm programmatic automated endpoint access...
apiAvailability.additional_information: Confirms presence of web access interfaces supporting machine discovery (e.g., OpenAPI, GraphQL, OAI-PMH).

reusability.title: Reusability
reusability.description: Assessment of how well data can be reused

licenseClarity.title: License Clarity
licenseClarity.description: Clear licensing information informs users about permitted uses, modifications, and redistribution of data, supporting legal compliance and responsible reuse. (RDA-R1.1-01M)
licenseClarity.placeholder: Toggle to confirm clear digital copyright usage permissions...
licenseClarity.additional_information: Requires standardized, machine-readable digital licenses (e.g., Creative Commons licenses).

provenanceInfo.title: Provenance Info
provenanceInfo.description: Provenance documentation tracks the origin, processing history, and transformations applied to data, supporting validation and trustworthiness assessment. (RDA-R1.2-01M)
provenanceInfo.placeholder: Toggle to confirm lineage recording validation...
provenanceInfo.additional_information: Confirms whether generation workflows, source transformation tools, and modification histories are documented.

communityStandards.title: Community Standards
communityStandards.description: Community-adopted standards ensure data compatibility within research domains and facilitate domain-specific tool integration and reuse. (RDA-R1.3-01D)
communityStandards.placeholder: Does structure fit regional target peer agreements?
communityStandards.additional_information: Validates compliance with established workflows defined by standard consensus groups within specific scientific domains.

documentationQuality.title: Documentation Quality
documentationQuality.description: Comprehensive documentation enables users to understand data structure, methodology, limitations, and proper usage for accurate interpretation and reuse.
documentationQuality.placeholder: Toggle to confirm contextual documentation availability...
documentationQuality.additional_information: Measures user readability thresholds for accompanying items such as data dictionaries, readmes, and methods descriptions.

citationGuidelines.title: Citation Guidelines
citationGuidelines.description: Clear citation guidelines ensure proper attribution and reproducibility, supporting research integrity and acknowledgment of data contributions.
citationGuidelines.placeholder: Toggle if structured tracking reference snippets are provided...
citationGuidelines.additional_information: Confirms explicit inclusion of sample reference text, BibTeX handles, or index formatting styles.

assessmentDate.title: Assessment Date
assessmentDate.description: Date when FAIRness assessment was conducted
assessmentDate.additional_information: Automatically set upon finishing processing operations.

assessmentMethod.title: Assessment Method
assessmentMethod.placeholder: Identify entity executing target metric checks...
assessmentMethod.additional_information: Documents whether the metric data was provided by repository self-reporting or verified by an automated checking tool.

overallFAIRScore.title: Overall FAIR Score
overallFAIRScore.additional_information: Calculated value weighting individual categories uniformly based on relative evaluation response flags.

cropTypes.description: Types of crops covered by the data
